tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge 'dun pa rnams la skyabs 'jug zhu yig bzhugs so// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pu tra ārya siṅgha bhyaḥ phul byung 'dul ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i shes bya'i gru gzings mi rtag gyis bskul rlung dar mngon par g.yo/ /yon tan nor bu'i ded dpon gdul bya dad 'dun bcas kyis legs blangs bstan pa'i snying po rin chen dbang / /ngo mtshar skye rgu'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtser mchod 'dul 'dzin mkhan po dge 'dun tsinda ma ṇi ka/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten phyag 'os 'phags tshogs yid bzhin dbang rgyal shākya'i sras po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag 'tshal gyi tshig sngon du btang nas/ bstan pa'i snying po spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed gzhung dri ma med pa la bshad sgrub kyi byi dor legs par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid can phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor sgo gsum gus pas zhu gsol/ deng yang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag snyigs mar spyod pa rnams la chos byed kyi gang zag dkon zhing / 'ga' zhig byung ba de la'ang nag phyogs kyi mi dang mi ma yin pa dag gis bar chad rtsom pa chos nyid yin pa ltar/ kho bo cag spun nas kyang rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang bye brag gyen du 'degs pa la lhod med zhu khul gyi thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la dal med brtson par bsams kyang / nag phyogs kyi mi min dag gis bar chad kyi rtags lta bus/ 'di lo lha bla ma/ mo kha rtsis bsdur sogs kyi lung babs la ngos cag mched kyi gtsos gdan sa 'di rang du gegs chags che tshul zhig byung ba dang / lhag par nu bo sngags 'chang par 'di lo khrag rlung stod 'tshangs lta bu'i gzugs gzhi ma bde bar 'phral 'phral du nad ldang yong ba zhig dang / nged rang la'ang rmi ltas ngan pa 'ga' zhig mu btud nas byung zhing /

rje btsun a ṇi drung dang mdzod pa bcas par rkang 'bam gyis gzugs gzhi ma bde ba sogs 'di lo phyi nang gsang gsum du 'gal rkyen gyi rtags shig btud mar byung ba 'di don la lha bla ma/ mo kha sogs gyi lung la babs pa'i rim gro rnams 'phral mar byas khul yin kyang bzang rtags gtan nas mi 'byung ba 'di don la dpag na/ nged rang mched kyis gtsos gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du dog cha shin tu che ba zhig yod mdog kha ba bcas/ da lam 'jam dang mang ja sbyor sbrel gyi thog nged mched kyi dngos po spong dag 'khor gsum yongs dag zhus pa 'di bzhin la dge 'dun rnams nas kyang thugs bsam che bskyed kyis rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag de 'dzin ces thugs dgongs su bcangs pa'i ched dmigs kyi rim gro gnang dgos la/ mang ja'i thog skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i gong bstod bsdus pa tshang ma dang khyad par yab rje'i sku bstod rgyas pa/ 'chi med dpal sbyin ma gzungs ring 'dod gsol bcas pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ ja rgyab la bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ mchog gsum bden gsol gyi ngos cag ring 'tsho'i gsol 'debs/ ched du mdo sgrol tshe gzungs la grangs gsog gang mang zhig dang / mjug bsngo smon shis brjod kyis brgyan pa bcas 'dus tshogs thams cad kyi ngos cag mched la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu gtad pa zhig gi rim gro smin grub bka' drin che skyong mkhyen/ dngos rigs rnams la tho zur gsal zhig phul yod pa tshang ma'i thugs 'jag zhu/ snying rje'i sa gzhir byang sems rlan dang thugs rje'i drod kyis yongs smin dpag bsam shing / /yon tan 'bras bu'i khur lci nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum khrims kyi lo 'dab rgyas/ /phan bde'i 'bras stsol 'dus tshogs ngur smrig 'dzin pa rkang 'thung dbang po'i bden tshig gis/ /kun blo mched kyi bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces 'dod don mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i ched du 'dus sde rin po cher 'jam mang ja spong dag gi bsnyen bkur bcas kyi thog dpyad khra 'di'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje dam pa'i bsti gnas phun tshogs 'chi med rdo rje'i gur khang nas mgyogs par bris pa dge legs 'phel// //swasti rastu// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dge 'dun pa rnams la skyabs 'jug zhu yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
